articles.title: A Shared ChatGPT Link Could Run Attacker Code in Your Session and Read Private Chats
articles.raw_summary:
A malicious ChatGPT share link could run an attacker's code in the logged-in session of anyone who opened it, allowing them to read their private conversations, researchers at the security firm Parameter showed.

The researchers reported the flaw through OpenAI's bug bounty program on October 18, and OpenAI fixed it eight days later and rated it P1, its most serious category.

articles.title: Show HN: NES Contra (1987) port (ASM –> C and then C –> WebAssembly)
articles.raw_summary:
Based on vermiceli's annotated disassembly of Contra: https://github.com/vermiceli/nes-contra-us. Thanks for the great work.

I ported it in two steps. First to C: the game logic is translated routine by routine from the 6502 assembly, and checked frame by frame against the original in the Mesen emulator. Then the C code to WebAssembly so it runs in the browser.

The cherry on top: online multiplayer, so two players can play co-op over the internet.

Source: https://github.com/epoyraz/nes-contra-us
